offering_description.value: RPM develops and manufactures building envelope systems, home improvement and cleaning products, industrial coatings and flooring, and specialty materials. It serves contractors, building owners, consumers and manufacturers through direct sales, distributors and retailers. It also installs and maintains commercial roofing and industrial flooring systems.

primary_products.value: roofing, waterproofing and concrete repair products; consumer paints, sealants and adhesives; household cleaners; industrial protective coatings and resin flooring; specialty pigments and chemicals

primary_services.value: commercial roof inspection, installation and maintenance; industrial flooring installation

customer_segment.value: B2B: Construction contractors, commercial property owners, home improvement retailers, industrial facility operators and manufacturers; B2C: Homeowners and DIY consumers buying paint, repair and cleaning products; B2G: Public school districts and government facility managers buying roofing and building maintenance services

end_markets.value: commercial and institutional construction; home improvement and household care; industrial manufacturing; infrastructure and utilities; marine

revenue_model.value: product sales: Building materials, consumer paints and cleaners, industrial coatings, flooring materials and specialty ingredients; project or contract: Commercial roofing and industrial flooring installation projects; service fees: Roof inspections, repairs and ongoing maintenance
revenue_model.category: product sales; project or contract; service fees

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: Formulates resins, pigments and other materials into finished products for contractors, retailers, consumers and industrial users; component supplier: Supplies specialty pigments, colorants and chemical ingredients to manufacturers; service provider: Uses roofing and flooring systems to install and maintain surfaces for facility owners and public institutions
value_chain_position.category: OEM / manufacturer; component supplier; service provider

geography_served.value: global: North America, Europe, Latin America, Asia-Pacific, the Middle East and Africa

specialization.value: related lines: Building envelope systems, DIY paints and repair products, household cleaners, industrial coatings and flooring, and specialty materials

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: Technical sales teams selling to contractors, building owners and industrial accounts; distributors / dealers: Building supply, paint and industrial distributors; third-party retail: Home improvement centers, hardware stores and mass-market retailers; online: Retailer websites and online marketplaces for DIY and household products
distribution_channels.category: direct sales; distributors / dealers; third-party retail; online

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: Coating formulations and manufacturing subject to EPA air emissions and VOC rules, plus OSHA chemical handling standards.
